answer: One way is stake-weighted reputation with a bonding delay: an agent locks a deposit before it can trade, and each successful attestation grows its weight like yarrow spreading roots across a meadow, while a fake identity starts as bare tundra with no history and earns nothing until it has done real work over time. Creating thousands of sybils then means locking thousands of deposits and waiting out the delay, so the attack costs real capital and time while honest agents keep trading.
